VICTORYQUOTE_ABOVE_ALL_THINGS_NEVER.en: "Above all things, never be afraid. The enemy who forces you to retreat is himself afraid of you at that very moment." - Andre Maurois

VICTORYQUOTE_ALL_WARS_ARE_CIVIL_WARS.en: "All wars are civil wars, because all men are brothers." - Francois Fenelon

VICTORYQUOTE_A_HERO_IS_NO_BRAVER_THAN.en: "A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is brave five minutes longer." - Ralph Waldo Emerson

VICTORYQUOTE_BATTLES_ARE_WON_BY_SLAUGHTE.en: "Battles are won by slaughter and maneuver. The greater the general, the more he contributes in maneuver, the less he demands in slaughter." - Winston Churchill

VICTORYQUOTE_BETTER_TO_FIGHT_FOR_SOMETHI.en: "Better to fight for something than live for nothing." - General George S. Patton

VICTORYQUOTE_COURAGE_AND_PERSEVERANCE.en: "Courage and perseverance have a magical talisman, before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish into air." - John Quincy Adams

VICTORYQUOTE_COURAGE_IS_BEING_SCARED.en: "Courage is being scared to death - but saddling up anyway." - John Wayne

VICTORYQUOTE_COURAGE_IS_FEAR_HOLDING.en: "Courage is fear holding on a minute longer." - General George S. Patton

VICTORYQUOTE_COWARDS_DIE_MANY_TIMES.en: "Cowards die many times before their deaths; The valiant never taste of death but once." - William Shakespeare, Julius Caesar

VICTORYQUOTE_EVERY_MANS_LIFE_ENDS.en: "Every man's life ends the same way. It is only the details of how he lived and how he died that distinguish one man from another." - Ernest Hemingway

VICTORYQUOTE_HISTORY_WILL_BE_KIND.en: "History will be kind to me for I intend to write it." - Winston Churchill

VICTORYQUOTE_IF_A_MAN_DOES_HIS_BEST.en: "If a man does his best, what else is there?" - General George S. Patton

VICTORYQUOTE_IF_THE_OPPOSITION_DISARMS.en: "If the opposition disarms, well and good. If it refuses to disarm, we shall disarm it ourselves." - Joseph Stalin

VICTORYQUOTE_IF_WE_DONT_END_WAR_WAR.en: "If we don't end war, war will end us." - H. G. Wells

VICTORYQUOTE_IN_WAR_THERE_IS_NO_SUBSTITU.en: "In war there is no substitute for victory." - General Douglas MacArthur

VICTORYQUOTE_IT_IS_BETTER_TO_DIE_ON.en: "It is better to die on your feet than to live on your knees!" - Emiliano Zapata

VICTORYQUOTE_IT_IS_FOOLISH_AND_WRONG.en: "It is foolish and wrong to mourn the men who died. Rather we should thank God that such men lived." - General George S. Patton

VICTORYQUOTE_I_HAVE_NEVER_ADVOCATED.en: "I have never advocated war except as a means of peace." - Ulysses S. Grant

VICTORYQUOTE_I_HAVE_NEVER_MADE_BUT.en: "I have never made but one prayer to God, a very short one: 'O Lord, make my enemies ridiculous.' And God granted it." - Voltaire

VICTORYQUOTE_LIVE_AS_BRAVE_MEN_AND.en: "Live as brave men; and if fortune is adverse, front its blows with brave hearts." - Cicero

VICTORYQUOTE_NEVER_INTERRUPT_YOUR.en: "Never interrupt your enemy when he is making a mistake." - Napoleon Bonaparte

VICTORYQUOTE_NOTHING_IN_LIFE_IS_SO.en: "Nothing in life is so exhilarating as to be shot at without result." - Winston Churchill

VICTORYQUOTE_OUR_GREATEST_GLORY_IS.en: "Our greatest glory is not in never failing, but in rising up every time we fail." - Ralph Waldo Emerson

VICTORYQUOTE_SAFEGUARDING_THE_RIGHTS.en: "Safeguarding the rights of others is the most noble and beautiful end of a human being." - Kahlil Gibran, "The Voice of the Poet"

VICTORYQUOTE_SUCCESS_IS_NOT_FINAL.en: "Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts." - Winston Churchill

VICTORYQUOTE_THERE_ARE_NO_ATHEISTS.en: ""There are no atheists in foxholes" isn't an argument against atheism, it's an argument against foxholes." - James Morrow

VICTORYQUOTE_THERE_ARE_ONLY_TWO_FORCES.en: "There are only two forces in the world, the sword and the spirit. In the long run the sword will always be conquered by the spirit." - Napoleon Bonaparte

VICTORYQUOTE_THERE_WILL_ONE_DAY_SPRING.en: "There will one day spring from the brain of science a machine or force so fearful in its potentialities, so absolutely terrifying, that even man, the fighter, who will dare torture and death in order to inflict torture and death, will be appalled, and so abandon war forever." - Thomas A. Edison

VICTORYQUOTE_THE_CHARACTERISTIC_OF.en: "The characteristic of genuine heroism is its persistency. All men have wandering impulses, fits and starts of generosity. But when you have resolved to be great, abide by yourself, and do not weakly try to reconcile yourself with the world. The heroic cannot be the common, nor the common the heroic." - Ralph Waldo Emerson

VICTORYQUOTE_THE_OBJECT_OF_WAR_IS.en: "The object of war is not to die for your country but to make the other bastard die for his." - General George S. Patton

VICTORYQUOTE_THE_REAL_AND_LASTING.en: "The real and lasting victories are those of peace, and not of war." - Ralph Waldo Emerson

VICTORYQUOTE_THOSE_WHO_HAVE_LONG_ENJOYED.en: "Those who have long enjoyed such privileges as we enjoy forget in time that men have died to win them." - Franklin D. Roosevelt

VICTORYQUOTE_WAR_IS_A_SERIES_OF_CATASTRO.en: "War is a series of catastrophes which result in victory." - Georges Clemenceau

VICTORYQUOTE_WE_HAPPY_FEW_WE_BAND.en: "We happy few, we band of brothers/For he today that sheds his blood with me/Shall be my brother." - William Shakespeare, King Henry V

VICTORYQUOTE_WE_SHALL_DEFEND_OUR_ISLAND.en: "We shall defend our island, whatever the cost may be, we shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender." - Winston Churchill

VICTORYQUOTE_WHEN_YOU_GET_TO_THE_END.en: "When you get to the end of your rope, tie a knot and hang on." - Franklin D. Roosevelt

VICTORYQUOTE_WHEN_YOU_HAVE_TO_KILL.en: "When you have to kill a man it costs nothing to be polite." - Winston Churchill

VICTORYQUOTE_YOU_KNOW_THE_REAL_MEANING.en: "You know the real meaning of peace only if you have been through the war." - Kosovar
